cases.question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.standalone_question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.answer_excerpt:
If you receive transfer credit for a course in a full-time program, your program tuition is generally not reduced, but your course load will be lighter. 

* **Tuition Impact:** While your course load decreases, your full-time program tuition does not go down. 
* **Transcript Submission:** To apply for transfer credit, your official transcript must be sent directly to BCIT from the institution(s) you previously attended, or dropped off in a sealed and stamped envelope. If you plan to request transfer credit, you should have your previous school send your official transcript directly to BCIT rather than uploading it with your application.

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: What is the refund policy if I withdraw from a course or program at BCIT after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you may still receive a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so before the official refund deadline and meet the requirements.

* **Full-Time Programs:** For most full-time programs, the latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of classes. Note that commitment fees are non-refundable and will be deducted from your refund (for example, $500 for technology and degree programs).
* **Flexible Learning Courses:** Refund eligibility depends on the course length and format. For classroom-based, blended, and synchronous courses longer than four weeks, you can receive an 85% tuition refund if you withdraw prior to the second class. For asynchronous online courses longer than four weeks, the deadline is within two weeks of the course start date for an 85% refund. Continual entry courses lasting more than two weeks allow a 100% refund if withdrawn within two weeks of registration or the course start date.
* **Apprenticeship Programs:** Refunds are available up to the third day of class (subject to a $200 non-refundable commitment fee if withdrawing up to 41 days prior), but no refunds are issued for withdrawals occurring nine days or less before the start of class.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/
sub_queries: BCIT refund policy for withdrawal after classes start

* Most full-time programs allow a refund if you withdraw within 10 business days after classes start.
